描述_EN: all these activities were to disappear when foot-binding was introduced at the end of the dynasty. they led a very active life, hunting and playing polo with their men-friends and relatives. they wore wigs which they manipulated into the most complicated hair-dos. they painted their faces with rouge and powder and wore all sorts of jewellery, including hairpins such as this pair. chinese women of the tang dynasty (618-907) were highly fashion-conscious.
描述_ZN: 所有这些活动都会在王朝末期引入裹脚布时消失。 他们过着非常活跃的生活，打猎和与他们的男性朋友和亲戚打马球。 她们戴着假发，并将其处理成最复杂的发型。 她们在脸上涂上胭脂水粉，戴上各种首饰，包括像这对发簪。 唐朝（618-907）的中国妇女非常注重时尚。
